description: Composite multi-region flowchart (chart_flow) of a 3D cellular-automaton (CA) DRX model built on inhomogeneous dislocation density, for low-alloy steel under varying deformation conditions. The upper "Inputs" band contains three boxes: "Load condition" (Temperatures of both stages; Strain rates of both stages; Start strain of second stage; End strain), illustrated by two schematic specimens labelled "First stage" (red) and "Second stage" (blue) separated by a red double arrow; "Initial microstructure" (Grain orientation; Grain size; Dislocation density; ……), shown as a 3D cube of multicoloured polyhedral grains; and "Model parameters" (Initial WH rate in Eq.(2) and (3); Saturation stress in Eq.(6); DRX activation energy in Eq.(12); ……). A blue "Parameters by constitutive calibration" box prints θ₀ = μ/K_T and σ_s = σ_ns sinh⁻¹[(Z_p/A_s)^{m_s}]. The lower half is the CA loop: "Step n" → diamond "ε ≥ ε₁", whose Y branch applies Stress softening coefficient k_s and Varying saturation stress σ_s^(v) → "Average dislocation density evolution based on Eq.(26)" → dashed "Inhomogeneous dislocation density evolution" block (Eq.(28); Eq.(30),(31); Eq.(29),(32)) beside a 3D contour cube → diamond "ρ ≥ ρ_c" → nucleation (Eq.35,36) → update dislocation density/grain orientation → grain-boundary migration (Eq.37–41) → update all state variables → "Last step" → "Output simulation results" (Grain orientation distribution; Dislocation density distribution). "Next step n=n+1" closes the cycle. The figure maps an algorithmic sequence and reports no data values.
measured_quantities: dislocation density ρ and critical ρ_c

observations.observation: The figure is a flowchart with an 'Inputs' band at the top and a CA simulation loop below, joined by arrows that form a closed cycle.
The 'Load condition' input box lists four check-box items: Temperatures of both stages, Strain rates of both stages, Start strain of second stage, End strain.

Two schematic cylindrical specimens labelled 'First stage' (red) and 'Second stage' (blue) are drawn under the Load condition box, separated by a vertical red double arrow indicating a change of deformation condition.
The 'Initial microstructure' box lists Grain orientation, Grain size and Dislocation density, and is accompanied by a 3D cube of multicoloured polyhedral (Voronoi-type) grains.
The 'Model parameters' box lists Initial WH rate in Eq.(2) and (3), Saturation stress in Eq.(6) and DRX activation energy in Eq.(12).
A blue 'Parameters by constitutive calibration' box prints the equations θ₀ = μ/K_T and σ_s = σ_ns sinh⁻¹[(Z_p/A_s)^{m_s}].

A decision diamond labelled 'ε ≥ ε₁' has a Y branch to a box listing 'Stress softening coefficient k_s' and 'Varying saturation stress σ_s^(v)'; both Y and N branches converge on 'Average dislocation density evolution based on Eq.(26)'.

A dashed block labelled 'Inhomogeneous dislocation density evolution' contains three sequential steps (Eq.(28); Eq.(30) and (31); Eq.(29) and (32)) beside a 3D cube contour-mapped in blue, green and yellow representing the inhomogeneous dislocation-density field.
A decision diamond 'ρ ≥ ρ_c' branches: N returns to the loop, Y leads to 'Inhomogeneous nucleation happens based on Eq.(35) and (36)'.

Downstream of nucleation the flow passes through 'Update dislocation density and grain orientation of nucleation sites', 'Calculate the migrations of grain boundaries based on Eq.(37)-(41)' and 'Update all state variables of cells' to a 'Last step' diamond.

The 'Last step' diamond's Y branch reaches the terminal box 'Output simulation results' listing 'Grain orientation distribution' and 'Dislocation density distribution'; its N branch returns to 'Next step n=n+1'.
The caption states the figure is the flowchart of a 3D CA model based on inhomogeneous dislocation density.
The citing text states the RVE used in the DRX simulation is 550 µm × 550 µm × 550 µm and the cell size L₀ is 2.5 µm.
The citing text states the model parameters (initial WH rate, saturation stress, DRX activation energy and others) were calibrated from the constitutive model in Section 3.1.
The citing text states the CA loop continues until the end strain and then outputs grain orientation distribution and dislocation density distribution.

subfigures.description: Inputs band: three side-by-side boxes 'Load condition', 'Initial microstructure', 'Model parameters', each with check-box items, plus a blue 'Parameters by constitutive calibration' box printing θ₀ = μ/K_T and σ_s = σ_ns sinh⁻¹[(Z_p/A_s)^{m_s}]. Under Load condition two schematic cylinders show the first and second deformation stages; under Initial microstructure a 3D Voronoi cube shows coloured grains.

Main CA loop: 'Next step n=n+1' feedback block, 'Step n' ellipse, decision diamond 'ε ≥ ε₁', a blue constitutive-calibration box (stress softening coefficient k_s, varying saturation stress σ_s^(v)) on the Y branch, and 'Average dislocation density evolution based on Eq.(26)' where both branches merge.

Dashed 'Inhomogeneous dislocation density evolution' block with three sequential equation-labelled steps and a 3D cube contour-mapped in blue-green-yellow; downstream ρ ≥ ρ_c diamond, nucleation, grain-boundary migration, cell-state update, 'Last step' diamond and terminal 'Output simulation results' box.

unreadable_items: Small blue inset curve inside the left 'Parameters by constitutive calibration' box is too low-resolution to read its axes or trend
Several input/parameter lists end with '……' so the full set of variables is truncated on the figure
Fine subscripts/superscripts of the printed equations (θ₀, σ_s, σ_ns, Z_p, A_s, m_s, K_T) are small and only partially readable
